2. **Austin Devereux Hines** (b. 1982) - Son from her relationship with actor David Hines
3. **Aron Wilson** (adopted 1988) - Adopted son from her relationship with musician Brian Wilson

Michelle was also married to both John Phillips (of The Mamas & The Papas) and Brian Wilson (of The Beach Boys), with whom she had two of her children through relationships/adoption.
